unknowns.why_it_matters: BV-01 (6 books) and EP-02 can only assert 'invalid', not the observable result.

unknowns.question: Is "between 1 and 3 books" inclusive at both ends — may an under-12 member borrow exactly 1 and exactly 3 books?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The boundary values of BV-02 (1 book) and BV-03 (3 books) cannot be marked valid or invalid.

quotes.text: between 1 and 3 books

unknowns.question: For under-12 members, does "between 1 and 3 books" count books on loan at a time (like the 5-book rule) or books per single borrowing? And what does the lower bound 1 restrict in practice?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Decides how BV-02/BV-03 and EP-03..EP-05 are set up (existing loans + new borrow vs. one transaction).

on loan at a time

unknowns.why_it_matters: BV-02 (0), BV-03 (4) and EP-04/EP-05 can only assert 'invalid', not the result.

unknowns.question: What happens on a 3rd (or later) renewal attempt?
unknowns.why_it_matters: BV-05 (3rd renewal) and EP-09 can only assert 'invalid', not the result.

unknowns.question: In which states can a loan be renewed (ACTIVE only? OVERDUE too?), what state results, and what does a renewal do to the loan period (another 14 days, from when)?
unknowns.why_it_matters: All renew cells of the ST matrix are unknown; the renewal effect also shifts the BV-06 boundary for renewed loans.

quotes.text: A loan can be renewed up to 2 times.

unknowns.question: State/action pairs not listed in 'Loan states' (e.g. returning a RESERVED loan, picking up an ACTIVE one, anything on RETURNED): are they illegal, and what happens? The spec has no blanket rule and doesn't say RETURNED is final.
unknowns.why_it_matters: 11 of 20 ST cells are unknown here (16 unknown in total with U-06 and U-08); negative state-transition tests have no expected result.

unknowns.question: How does a loan come into existence — does every borrow start as RESERVED, or can a member borrow straight into ACTIVE? Is 'borrow' the same as 'pick up'?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The borrowing limits (BV-01..BV-05, BV-09) are worded as 'borrow' but no transition says which action that is, so the limit checks cannot be tied to a state transition.
